schema.description: ISA-95 MaterialClass (Part 2): material definitions that share properties. A class may include the properties of a broader class and be assembled from other classes (PA66-GF30 from PA66 and glass fibre). Domain profiles such as ThermoplasticClass add typed properties.

material_class_id.description: Identity of the material class (e.g. PA66-GF30).

parent_class_ref.description: The broader class whose properties this class includes (INCLUDES_PROPERTIES_OF).

assembly_type.description: ISA-95 AssemblyType: Physical (the parts are physically joined) or Logical (a grouping, e.g. a compound of polymer and filler).

assembly_relationship.description: ISA-95 AssemblyRelationship: Permanent (cannot be taken apart again) or Transient (temporary, e.g. a kit).

relationships.description: Class hierarchy (B2MML MaterialClass.MaterialClassBaseID): e.g. PA66-GF30 includes the properties of PA66.
The classes this class is assembled from (B2MML MaterialClass.AssemblyClass, ISA-95 Part 2 cl. 5.7), e.g. PA66-GF30 from PA66 and glass fibre; one edge per component, delivered by the source.

isa95.note: ISA-95 Part 2 MaterialClass: hierarchy by INCLUDES_PROPERTIES_OF (MaterialClassBaseID), composition by ASSEMBLED_FROM (AssemblyClass) with AssemblyType and AssemblyRelationship.
